item.title: Create an Image Builder Using Source Code
item.description: This section describes how to build source code into container images (S2I). After the image builder starts running, it will automatically perform the following operations: Connect to the user-specified source code repository and retrieve the source code for the application. Use the image builder to build the source code into a container image. Push the container image to the user-specified image service.

item.title: Create an Image Builder Using Artifacts
item.description: This section describes how to build artifacts into container images (B2I). After the image builder starts running, it will automatically perform the following operations: Use the image builder to build the user-uploaded artifact files into container images. Push the container image to the user-specified image service. Example Artifacts The following are some example artifacts for demonstration and testing: Artifact Package GitHub Repository b2i-war-java8.
